interpretation: On this generated fixture DeepFilterNet improved aligned speech SI-SDR more and strongly attenuated the click; Clear retained substantially more click energy. decision_reason: No blind independent agent labels or bounded real-footage evaluation are present. Keep cleanup query-triggered and separate from source separation.
limitations: TTS speech is not a natural speaker or human reference annotation.
One synthetic mixture and one transient do not represent difficult real dialogue/music overlap.
Clear and DeepFilterNet are dialogue enhancement systems, not general source separators.
